name: USDX
oneLiner: USDX is Kava Mint's legacy CDP dollar, sustained by crypto-collateralized debt positions and currently trading at a material discount to peg.
collateral: Kava CDP collateral and protocol liquidity backing the legacy USDX debt token
pegMechanism: Kava Mint overcollateralized debt positions issue USDX against crypto collateral, with liquidations and protocol parameters intended to defend the peg

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Kava's tagged kava-3 release identifies the first software release containing the complete CDP system, and its versioned migration instructions set the replacement chain genesis to 2020-06-10T14:00:00Z. These primary sources establish the USDX CDP implementation boundary.

oracleRisk.summary: Kava Mint prices each collateral type through a governance-whitelisted x/pricefeed market whose reports are medianized onchain; liquidation uses the configured per-type liquidation market, while a missing price suspends price-dependent CDP operations rather than switching to a secondary feed.

branchApplicability.rationale: Kava documents each CDP as scoped to one collateral type, and current x/cdp parameters assign each type its own liquidation ratio and price-feed market. The common x/cdp liquidation and auction engine is reviewed as one grouped branch with every current collateral type and feed path enumerated.

branches.label: Kava Mint current x/cdp collateral types
branches.summary: Ten current x/cdp collateral parameter sets use eight liquidation-market paths through Kava's common medianized x/pricefeed and common collateral/debt auction engine.
branches.fallbackBehavior: The x/cdp module checks each collateral pricefeed at the beginning of a block. If no price is returned, it suspends liquidation, fee accrual, collateral deposits and withdrawals, CDP creation, and new debt draws for that collateral until a price is reported; no secondary feed is documented.

branches.liquidationMechanism: The current x/cdp configuration performs its periodic liquidation sweep every 50 blocks. When a checked CDP is below its type's liquidation ratio, the module seizes its collateral and debt, splits collateral into auction lots, sells it for USDX, and burns the recovered USDX against seized debt. No separate post-detection grace period is specified, but execution is subject to the periodic sweep rather than continuous checking.
branches.backstop: If collateral auctions do not recover the desired USDX, the shortfall enters global system debt; once the configured threshold is reached, debt auctions mint and sell KAVA governance tokens for USDX to recapitalize the CDP system.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: A missing collateral price suspends that collateral's price-dependent CDP operations until reporting resumes. Failed collateral-auction recovery is tracked as global debt and handled by KAVA debt auctions; the reviewed module documentation does not describe a separate global settlement path.

notices.title: Legacy depeg risk
notices.message: USDX trades at a material discount to its dollar peg, sustained by legacy debt positions on Kava Mint CDPs. Use live runtime data for the current discount; Pharos tracks the active provider entry separately from the historical cemetery incident.

mintAuthority.summary: USDX is minted by Kava's x/cdp module account (minter/burner) when users draw against overcollateralized CDPs, bounded by per-collateral debt limits and an 8,723,000 USDX global debt limit. Caps and collateral params are raiseable by the 5-member Kava Stability Committee (3-of-5, 7-day proposal) and by KAVA stake governance. There is no proxy: mint logic changes via a Cosmos x/upgrade software upgrade whose authority is the gov module account, reachable by stake vote (20% quorum, 50% threshold, 33.4% veto, 7-day) and by the 1-member Kava Safety Committee holding SoftwareUpgradePermission, though enactment still requires validator binary adoption.

controls.label: Kava x/cdp module account (USDX minter)
controls.capDescription: Global debt limit 8,723,000 USDX (8723000000000 uusdx, conversion factor 6) plus 10 per-collateral debt limits and liquidation ratios enforced by x/cdp.
controls.evidence: At Kava height 21631632, /cosmos/auth/v1beta1/module_accounts returned module cdp at kava1wq9ts6l7atfn45ryxrtg4a2gwegsh3xha9e6rp with permissions [minter, burner]. /kava/cdp/v1beta1/params returned debt_param denom usdx (conversion_factor 6, debt_floor 10000000), global_debt_limit 8723000000000 uusdx, and 10 collateral params each with its own debt limit. The module mints USDX only on CDP draw within those bounds and cannot raise its own limit.

controls.label: Kava Stability Committee (x/committee id 1)
controls.evidence: At Kava height 21631632, committee id 1 (Kava Stability Committee) is a MemberCommittee with 5 members, vote_threshold 0.5, TALLY_OPTION_FIRST_PAST_THE_POST and proposal_duration 604800s, so 3 of 5 member votes carry a proposal. Its ParamsChangePermission covers 23 keys including cdp/GlobalDebtLimit, cdp/CollateralParams and cdp/DebtParam, so it can raise the USDX debt cap without a stake vote. It holds no direct mint permission.

controls.label: Kava on-chain governance (x/gov module account)
controls.evidence: At Kava height 21631632, /cosmos/upgrade/v1beta1/authority returned kava10d07y265gmmuvt4z0w9aw880jnsr700jxh8cq5, which /cosmos/auth/v1beta1/module_accounts confirms is the gov module account. KAVA stake governance can therefore schedule x/upgrade software upgrades that rewrite x/cdp mint logic, and can change any x/cdp param including GlobalDebtLimit. Tally params: quorum 0.2, threshold 0.5, veto_threshold 0.334, voting_period 604800s. No upgrade is currently scheduled (/cosmos/upgrade/v1beta1/current_plan returned plan null).

controls.label: Kava Safety Committee (x/committee id 2)
controls.evidence: At Kava height 21631632, committee id 2 (Kava Safety Committee) is a MemberCommittee with a single member (kava1e0agyg6eug9r62fly9sls77ycjgw8ax6xk73es), vote_threshold 0.5, TALLY_OPTION_FIRST_PAST_THE_POST, proposal_duration 604800s, and SoftwareUpgradePermission as its sole permission. One member vote therefore carries a chain software-upgrade proposal that could rewrite x/cdp mint logic; enactment still requires validators to adopt the new binary.

review.evidence: All facts read from the Kava LCD https://api.data.kava.io at height 21631632 (chain_id kava_2222-10) on 2026-07-14: x/cdp params (debt denom usdx, global debt limit 8723000000000 uusdx, 10 collateral debt limits); module accounts (cdp = kava1wq9ts6l7... with minter/burner, gov = kava10d07y265...); committees (id 1 Stability, 3-of-5, holds cdp GlobalDebtLimit/CollateralParams/DebtParam param rights; id 2 Safety, 1-of-1, holds SoftwareUpgradePermission); x/upgrade authority = gov module account; gov tally quorum 0.2 / threshold 0.5 / veto 0.334 / 7-day voting. /kava/evmutil/v1beta1/params lists no usdx conversion pair, so USDX has no ERC-20 representation and no EIP-1967 proxy surface to review.
